gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-lexend-tera: Authoritative up top, Lisu Bosa leans literary. Lexend Tera spreads out in a single-weight line, while Lisu Bosa's gentle thick-to-thin shifts do the shaping and Lexend Tera's open, widely spaced plain sans letters do the airing.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-lexend-zetta: Approachable Lexend Zetta runs widely tracked, tall-bodied and constant in width beneath the literary, softly modulated strokes of Lisu Bosa. Ink meets ribbon.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-montserrat-alternate: Montserrat Alternates crowds its lowercase up toward the capital line, with a wide-open c. Lisu Bosa does the dignified work of soft thick-thin shifts, and Montserrat Alternates keeps every stroke uniform.
gen-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-fs-bespoke-serif: Scrawled, narrow and casual, Liu Jian Mao Cao draws every curve as heavy as its stems, then hands over to a serif with thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones. Bespoke Serif holds a dignified line with only a slight shift.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-gambetta: Expressive Love Ya Like A Sister stays low and level, with crossbars as thick as its stems. Gambetta follows with a noticeable but never dramatic shift in stroke weight, which makes paragraphs feel bookish and graceful.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-abyssini: Abyssinica SIL reads like brushed watercolor, with a quiet shift in line weight and a big, tall middle zone. Abyssinica SIL keeps that moderate contrast going through long stretches, so literary paragraphs feel classic rather than stark or flat.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-cambo: Refined Cambo takes a short step from lowercase top to capital top, with a modest thick and thin rhythm across each word, under the outlined, single-thickness Love Ya Like A Sister. Boldness meets restraint.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-manuale: Manuale reads large-eyed and traditional, with stroke contrast that stays moderate. Manuale does the fine-grained editorial work, while Love Ya Like A Sister, with no thick and thin parts in any letter, brings the bold display punch.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noto-nas: Rounded-rod letters of one weight, with ascenders barely clearing the x-height, define Love Ya Like A Sister. And Noto Naskh Arabic adds a very tall x-height and softly varied strokes, like lightly engraved brass, as a refined text serif.

Glass-tube lettering, hollow and constant in thickness, gives Love Ya Like A Sister its bold look. Noto Nastaliq Urdu, a dignified serif with tight vertical rhythm, would turn clumsy if the body were made large.
